display.title: Episode 374: The Vanishing Bottle of Wine (Chol HaMoed Pesach)
display.summary_short: On Chol HaMoed Pesach: a shammes's strange dream saves his town from a false accusation, and Sefiras HaOmer teaches that time is a precious gift.
display.summary_long: Broadcast on Chol HaMoed Pesach 5749. Uncle Yossi explains that leaving Egypt freed our bodies, but freedom was complete only 49 days later, when receiving the Torah freed our souls; now we pray for a Geulah of body and soul. After a Pesach Hakochainik march, a third-grade class from a Boro Park girls' school leads the Shema. The Pesach story begins with 'Hashem is the Guardian of Israel, He neither slumbers nor sleeps' and the Haggadah's promise that in every generation Hashem saves us. Reb Arele, a devoted shammes who sleeps in the shul's attic, dreams three times that a voice asks him, 'Where is the wine for Pesach?' He goes down at night and finds that the bottle of wine he keeps in the Aron Kodesh has been swapped for a bottle of blood, the work of a wicked man who plans to accuse the Jews before the king. Reb Arele quietly replaces it, and when the accuser bursts in with the king on Pesach, the plot falls apart. Uncle Yossi then teaches a lesson of Sefiras HaOmer: time is a precious gift from Hashem, so do not waste it, as a story about a lost dime shows.The show ends with the coming 'parade out of galus' led by children, and an invitation to join Tzivos Hashem.
display.lesson: Hashem, the Guardian of Israel, never sleeps; and every day is a precious gift, so fill your time with Torah and mitzvos.
